steps.text: All journal fillets on the In-line crankshafts must have a .130 " to .160 " radius and on the 6V and 8V crankshafts, a .100 " to .130" radius between the crank cheek and the journal, and must not have any sharp grind marks (Fig. 9). The fillet must blend smoothly into the journal and the crank cheek, and must be free of scratches. The radius may be checked with a fillet gage.
